notes: Logo: vector reconstruction (potrace, 1 colour #000000) of the 2196x868 transparent 'CJ SAX / LIVE' wordmark PNG from cjsax.com; QA meanAbsDiff 2.16 on white. It is not the business's own vector file. Black mark on transparent, so shown on a light plate.
Reel: 5 video clips + 1 photo still, all from cjsax.com's own media library/uploads (VideoPress files titled 'CJ SAX @ ...'); audio stripped. Performer identity relies on those media titles.

Reel clips 2 (O Beach Ibiza) and 3 (Botley's Mansion) were cut from the original 1080x1920 HLG/HEVC uploads (same VideoPress IDs as the HD transcodes in the record) for sharper desktop crops; decoded without HDR tone mapping.
Reel outputs were losslessly retagged to BT.709 colour metadata after reel.py build, because the first source carried BT.2020 tags that would otherwise apply to the whole reel.
Reel size: desktop 5.23 MB + mobile 5.19 MB = 10.4 MB, above the ~9 MB target (busy crowd footage at the tool's fixed CRF 26).

Excluded footage: the CJ SAX SHOWREEL, Soultown Festival, Garden Party, Maldives and wedding-1 clips (burned-in 'CJ SAX LIVE EVENTS' watermark); TikTok exports (TikTok watermark); brunch films (letterboxed, text overlays, mostly guests and network DJs); clips whose performer is unclear.
Reel and gallery show identifiable adult event guests (wedding dance floors, Ibiza and festival crowds); no children were visible in the chosen clips.
Gallery photo-02 (Ushuaïa Ibiza stage) carries a small Ushuaïa venue watermark in the bottom-right corner; it is probably a venue photographer's image that CJ publishes on his homepage.

Photos featuring celebrities (rio-wedding.jpg, IMG_9611_polarr.jpg with the Nusr-Et chef, tinie-tempah.jpg, 413-1.jpg with Rio Ferdinand) were left out of the gallery pending image-rights permission, as flagged in the research record.
photo-04 is the image supplied by the business for its Booked Events listing (1000x800, not upscaled).

Oct 27 photo upgrade: card and gallery re-selected from original-resolution uploads on the business's own site and its own uploads on the old Booked Events site; AI renders, other businesses' images, private names and celebrity/watermarked shots excluded.
